async function run(items, read) {
 for (const user of batch) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all([read(user), notify(user)]);
 }
 for (const user of receive(queue, 10)) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.allSettled([read(user), notify(user)]);
 }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const piece of parts) { await Promise.all(piece.map(read)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const piece of grouped.parts) { await Promise.allSettled(piece.map(read)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const [index, piece] of parts.entries()) { await Promise.all(piece.map(read)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const piece of promises) { await Promise.all([...piece]); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const piece of parts) { console.log('await'); await Promise.all(piece.map(read)); }
 for (const piece of parts) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(other.map(read));
 }
 const oneGroup = {parts: split(items, 1)};
 for (const piece of oneGroup.parts) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(piece.map(read));
 }
 const ONE = 1;
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const piece of split(items, ONE)) { await Promise.all(piece.map(read)); }
 const individual = [];
 for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) individual.push(items.slice(i, i + 1));
 for (const piece of individual) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(piece.map(read));
 }
 const singles = split(items, 1);
 for (const piece of singles) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(piece.map(read));
 }
 for (const piece of split(items, 1)) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(piece.map(read));
 }
 for (const piece of parts) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await inspect(piece);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(piece.map(read));
 }
 for (const piece of parts) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(piece.map(read));
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(piece.map(notify));
 }
 for (const piece of batches) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await inspect(piece);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(piece.map(read));
 }
 for (const piece of parts) {
  for (const item of piece) {
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
   await Promise.all([read(item), notify(item)]);
  }
 }
}
